aboutGame.title: What is Pax Autocratica?
paragraphs: The official site frames Pax Autocratica as a satirical totalitarian colony sim crossed with an FPS roguelite. Its advertised loop moves from shaping a population and building the state apparatus to expeditions and combat.
This is the Multiverse game on Steam App ID 1067360. Platform, pricing, and release details can change, so the linked primary pages remain the source of truth for access and updates.

seo.title: Pax Autocratica Gameplay Guide | Core Loop
seo.description: Pax Autocratica Gameplay explains the colony-to-frontier loop, a safe three-step start, and which hands-on details still need current-build checks.

pages.direct_answer: Pax Autocratica is a satirical totalitarian colony sim combined with an FPS roguelite. Start by reading the colony and state-apparatus layer, then follow the frontier expedition and combat loop; this is a practical orientation, not a promise of a complete control or build guide.

sections.heading: What the official sources establish
paragraphs: The official site presents population control and state-apparatus building as the management side of the game, then connects that state to expeditions and first-person combat. The launch video reinforces that colony-to-frontier framing.

sections.heading: How to use this information
paragraphs: Treat the loop as the reliable starting map: understand the colony and decree layer first, then look for the frontier expedition and combat layer. Check the official pages before relying on a third-party guide for controls or progression.
steps: Read the official gameplay framing.
Use the live Steam entry for current access.
